description: This source file defines a Roslyn code fix provider class 'AliasClashAttributeCodeFix' used to detect and fix alias clash attributes in C# code analysis. It handles diagnostics related to alias name conflicts by generating code actions that modify the source code to resolve name clashes.

classes.name: AliasClashAttributeCodeFix
classes.description: A Roslyn code fix provider class that offers code fixes for alias clash diagnostics in C# source code, particularly for alias naming conflicts detected by the associated analyzer.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers code fixes for alias clash diagnostics found in the document, updating the attribute argument with a new alias name.

methods.name: GetFixAllProvider
methods.description: Returns the fix-all provider used to apply fixes across multiple instances.
